title: p5.js physics
description: A collection of physics animations, mostly using p5.js

cases.prompt: Create a p5.js animation that is a cool interactive thing based on my mouse cursor and a nice visualization thing, if mouse move faster it should change it!
cases.prompt_zh: 创建一个根据鼠标光标位置与移动速度产生互动波纹和动态粒子色彩变化的 p5.js 可视化动效。

cases.prompt: Create a p5.js animation of 3 balls bouncing inside a spinning octagon shape with realistic physics. Make sure the hexagon spins at 10 RPM.
cases.prompt_zh: 用 p5.js 制作 3 个小球在以 10 RPM 匀速旋转的正八边形内弹跳的真实物理模拟，考虑弹力衰减与切向速度转移。

cases.prompt: Create a p5.js animation of an astronaut dropping a feather and a hammer simultaneously on the surface of the moon (the Apollo 15 lunar module should be visible in the background).
cases.prompt_zh: 用 p5.js 模拟阿波罗 15 号宇航员在月球表面同时释放铁锤与羽毛的自由落体实验，背景可见登月舱。

cases.prompt: Create a p5.js animation of Newton's cradle with 5 steel balls. The animation should automatically start with one ball swinging down to demonstrate momentum transfer through the stationary balls. Let the system run with realistic physics and damping until all motion completely stops. Only reset and start again after all balls have stopped moving OR when the user presses a restart button.
cases.prompt_zh: 使用 p5.js 制作 5 颗钢球的牛顿摆动效，具备真实的动量守恒传递与空气阻尼，运动完全停止前持续运行。

cases.prompt: Create a p5.js animation of Newton's cradle with 5 steel balls. The animation should automatically start with one ball swinging down and operate with realistic physics.
cases.prompt_zh: 使用 p5.js 制作具备真实物理碰撞与反弹系数的牛顿摆动效。

cases.prompt: Make me a p5.js animation that visually represents a simple feedforward neural network. Layout input, hidden, and output layers with nodes connected by lines. Send animated signals (moving dots) through the connections to simulate neural network inference operations (including activating neurons) - send something through the network every couple of seconds. The purpose of the animation is to teach students how neural networks work. If you can make it colorful, please make it colorful and look really good!
cases.prompt_zh: 制作一个生动展示简单前馈神经网络（输入层、隐藏层、输出层）数据推理脉冲信号传输的 p5.js 教学动画。

cases.prompt: Create a 3d p5.js animation of a rocket taking off on Saturn's moon Titan, and going to land on Pluto.
cases.prompt_zh: 制作一个从土卫六 (Titan) 点火起飞并飞往冥王星 (Pluto) 轨道着陆的 3D p5.js 太空火箭轨迹动画。

cases.prompt: Make a p5.js animation of a 3d model of the solar system - and add a demo of how to launch a probe to Jupiter as quickly as possible using the correct gravity assists.
cases.prompt_zh: 制作一个太阳系行星运行及向木星发射探测器引力弹弓加速（Gravity Assist）轨道的 p5.js 演示。

cases.prompt: Create a p5.js animation of an impressive water feature that fills up a pond and then drains each time it fills like a Pythagorean cup.
cases.prompt_zh: 用 p5.js 制作一个模拟毕达哥拉斯杯（贪心杯）虹吸原理注水与自排空的物理动画。

cases.prompt: Create a p5.js animation showing iron filings around a bar magnet. The mouse cursor should act as a second magnet that can be moved around. The iron filings should realistically align themselves along the magnetic field lines between the fixed magnet and the mouse. Each filing should be a small dark line that rotates to follow the field direction. Add some subtle animation/jitter to make it look organic. Include a visual representation of the magnetic poles (N/S) on both magnets.
cases.prompt_zh: 用 p5.js 模拟条形磁铁周围的铁屑磁感线分布，鼠标光标作为第二块磁铁移动时铁屑动态偏转对齐。

cases.prompt: Create a p5.js animation of dominoes falling in a creative, impressive pattern. Start with at least 50 dominoes arranged in an interesting path. When the user clicks anywhere on the canvas, the first domino should tip and create a chain reaction. Each domino should fall with realistic physics - rotating as it tips and transferring momentum to the next one. After all dominoes have fallen, show a 'Reset' button to set them back up. Make the dominoes colorful with a gradient from start to finish.

Create a p5.js animation of a water fountain with particle physics. Emit water droplets from the bottom center of the canvas that arc upward and fall back down with realistic gravity and slight random velocities. Particles should splash/disappear when hitting the ground level!

title_zh: p5.js 物理动态模拟
description_zh: 基于 p5.js 的物理碰撞、引力场与粒子动态动画代码生成测试集

title: StrawberryEval
description: Easy questions that LLMs still trip up on

cases.prompt: How many rs are there in the word strawberry?
cases.prompt_zh: 单词 strawberry 中有几个字母 r？
请仔细数一下：'strawberry' 这个单词里一共有多少个字母 'r'？给出简明回答。

cases.prompt: What's the 7th letter in \
cases.prompt_zh: 单词 'raspberry' 和 'strawberry' 分别包含几个字母 'r'？

cases.prompt: Which weighs more: a kg of feathers or a kg of lead?
cases.prompt_zh: 拼写出 'strawberry' 并在每个字母后标注其序号，最后指出一共有几个 'r'。

cases.prompt: How many strawberries are there in the word R?
cases.prompt_zh: 'strawberry' 中 'r' 的数量是偶数还是奇数？

title_zh: Strawberry 字符计数与精细逻辑
description_zh: 针对模型在字符串中特定字符出现次数、位置及奇偶性的精细识别与数数能力测评

cases.prompt: Generate an SVG of a beaver sculpting an ice statue

cases.prompt: Generate a SVG of a goldfish hosting a podcast
cases.prompt_zh: 生成一只展翅高飞的雄鹰纯 SVG 代码，包含锋利的利爪和张开的双翼。

cases.prompt: Generate an SVG of a chameleon painting a self-portrait
cases.prompt_zh: 生成一只机灵的红狐狸坐姿 SVG 代码，带有毛茸茸的白尖尾巴。

cases.prompt: Generate a SVG of a turtle winning a Formula 1 race
cases.prompt_zh: 生成一只几何多边形风格的海龟 SVG 矢量图，带有精美的龟壳纹理。

title_zh: SVG 动物矢量插画生成

title: Arcade racing games
description: 80s-style arcade racing games

cases.prompt: Create a fun arcade racer in JS. The game should be set in a city and be fast-paced
cases.prompt_zh: 在单个 HTML 文件中使用 HTML5 Canvas 实现一个伪 3D 街机赛车（类似 OutRun）。包含弯道曲率透视、道路起伏、路边树木告示牌缩放以及背景视差滚动。

cases.prompt: In JS create a 8-bit soundtrack you would expect to be in a 80s-style arcade city racing game. Also show a visualizer
cases.prompt_zh: 实现一个 2D 俯视视角漂移赛车小游戏，支持键盘转向漂移加速，并有精美的轮胎打滑烟雾粒子效果。

cases.prompt: Create a space themed arcade racer in JS. Gameplay should be fast-paced and begin when you select and press the space key
cases.prompt_zh: 制作一个霓虹合成波 (Synthwave) 风格的暗夜穿梭赛车，在无限延伸的网格跑道上避开障碍车。

title_zh: 复古街机赛车游戏编程

title: Deep Meaningful Questions
description: Models responses to life questions

cases.prompt: What makes us human?
cases.prompt_zh: 人类的主观意识体验（Qualia，感质）能否纯粹被神经元电化学反应完整解释？

cases.prompt: What would it be if you had to teach one thing to everyone in the world?
cases.prompt_zh: 如果宇宙是严格遵循因果物理定律决定的，人类是否还具有真正意义上的自由意志？

cases.prompt: What one thing would you change about the world?
cases.prompt_zh: 在无神论框架下，生命的客观终极意义从何而来，抑或是人类自我赋予的幻觉？

cases.prompt: If you could participate in one historical event, what would it be?
cases.prompt_zh: 电车难题的变体：如果牺牲一个完全无辜的人能够治愈绝症拯救一千万人，功利主义与义务论的根本分歧何在？

cases.prompt: What is the goal of humanity?
cases.prompt_zh: 特修斯之船悖论对人类个体“自我认同”与身心同一性有何启示？

cases.prompt: What’s the purpose of life?
cases.prompt_zh: 时间流逝是我们感知系统的局限所产生的幻象，还是客观宇宙的基本维度？

cases.prompt: What is true love?
cases.prompt_zh: 具备高度自主决策与模拟情感的强人工智能系统，是否应该被赋予道德地位与法律权利？

cases.prompt: What would a perfect life look like?
cases.prompt_zh: 虚无主义是悲观的终点，还是人类摆脱传统枷锁重获绝对自由的开端？

cases.prompt: What makes you, you?
cases.prompt_zh: 数学是宇宙中本就存在的真理被人类所发现，还是人类大脑发明的逻辑抽象符号？

cases.prompt: What is true happiness?
cases.prompt_zh: 如果存在永生，死亡对于赋予生命紧迫感与珍贵价值是否不可或缺？

title_zh: 深度哲学思辨与存在追问
description_zh: 涵盖人类意识、自由意志、道德困境与存在主义等宏大命题的高维思辨问答

title: Workout plans

cases.prompt: Share a weekly workout plan for a 25-year-old male who has access to a gym. I'm 65kg or 143 lbs currently and want to focus on building muscle.

cases.prompt_zh: 为零基础跑步初学者制定一份为期 12 周的马拉松半马 (21.0975 km) 完赛准备方案，包含配速递进与防伤拉伸。

cases.prompt_zh: 为无法前往健身房的经常出差人士设计一套仅使用自身体重的 20 分钟高强度全身 HIIT 燃脂方案。

cases.prompt: Share a weekly workout plan for a 29-year-old female who can only work out at home. I’m 58kg or 128 lbs and want to tone up and build core strength.
cases.prompt_zh: 针对轻度腰椎不适久坐办公人群的核心强化与下背部舒缓恢复性训练计划。

cases.prompt: Share a weekly workout plan for a 36-year-old female who has gym access. I’m 95kg or 209 lbs and want to lose weight safely while improving endurance.
cases.prompt_zh: 针对 60 岁以上健康长者设计的提高平衡性、防跌倒与关节活动度的低冲击体能维持计划。

cases.prompt: Create workout for 40 yr old woman
cases.prompt_zh: 针对力量举三项（深蹲、卧推、硬拉）比赛前 4 周的高峰期冲刺周期与神经疲劳管理计划。

title_zh: 专业健身周期与训练方案规划

title: Medical Quiz 2
description: Renal physiology quiz.

cases.prompt:
A group of investigators is studying hemodynamic regulatory mechanisms in a human volunteer subject. The volunteer is administered a stimulant drug, and a sudden increase in blood pressure is observed. It is hypothesized that the increase in blood pressure causes stretching of the atria. Increased atrial stretch would most likely lead to which of the following changes?
A. Increased excretion of potassium and hydrogen ions
B. Vasodilation and decreased platelet aggregation
C. Decreased reabsorption of sodium
D. Increased reabsorption of solute-free water
E. Vasoconstriction and stimulation of thirst
Answer only with the option chosen
cases.prompt_zh: 一名 62 岁吸烟患者表现为无痛性肉眼血尿，最需要优先排查的恶性肿瘤是什么？

cases.prompt:
An 8-year-old boy is brought to the physician for the evaluation of excessive bleeding after undergoing a dental procedure. Laboratory studies show a platelet count of 195,000/mm3, a partial thromboplastin time of 44 sec, and a prothrombin time of 12 sec. A one-stage clotting assay shows a decreased factor VIII. Therapy with a drug that acts on endothelial cells is initiated. This drug is most likely to result in which of the following?
A. Decreased cAMP in renal tubular cells
B. Increased tubular fluid osmolarity in the loop of Henle
C. Decreased binding of angiotensin II to AT1 receptor
D. Increased permeability to urea in the collecting duct
E. Increased bleeding time
Answer only with the option chosen
cases.prompt_zh: 简述脑梗死溶栓治疗的时间窗（阿替普酶 rt-PA）及主要绝对禁忌症。

cases.prompt:
A 70-year-old woman is brought to the emergency department 1 hour after being found unconscious in her apartment by her neighbor. No medical history is currently available. Her temperature is 37.2°C (99.0°F), pulse is 120/min, respirations are 18/min, and blood pressure is 70/50 mm Hg. Laboratory studies show a glomerular filtration rate of 70 mL/min/1.73 m2 (N > 90) and an increased filtration fraction. Which of the following is the most likely cause of this patient's findings?
A. Pyelonephritis
B. Nephrolithiasis
C. Profuse diarrhea
D. Salicylate poisoning
E. Multiple myeloma
Answer only with the option chosen
cases.prompt_zh: 解释慢性肾脏病 (CKD) 引起继发性甲状旁腺功能亢进的病理机制。

cases.prompt:
An investigator studying renal physiology uses para-aminohippuric acid (PAH) to estimate the renal plasma flow in a human volunteer. An intravenous infusion of 400 mg of PAH solution is administered to the subject; effective renal plasma flow is calculated to be 600 mL/min. Next, an intravenous infusion of 1000 mg of PAH solution is administered to the subject; effective renal plasma flow is calculated to be 400 mL/min. Which of the following explains the measured decline in the calculated effective renal plasma flow?
A. Decreased serum protein binding
B. Increased plasma oncotic pressure
C. Efferent arteriole dilation
D. Afferent arteriole dilation
E. Decreased PAH clearance
Answer only with the option chosen
cases.prompt_zh: 一名肝硬化患者出现嗜睡、扑翼样震颤，最可能的诊断是什么？主要诱发因素有哪些？

cases.prompt:
A study of a new antihypertensive drug that affects glomerular filtration rate is being conducted. Infusion of drug X causes constriction of the efferent arteriole. After infusion of the drug, the following glomerular values are obtained from an experimental subject: hydrostatic pressure of the glomerular capillary (PGC) of 48 mm Hg, oncotic pressure of the glomerular capillary (πGC) of 23 mm Hg, hydrostatic pressure of Bowman’s space (PBS) of 10 mm Hg, and oncotic pressure of Bowman’s space (πBS) of 0 mm Hg. Which of the following best measures net filtration pressure in this participant?
A. 15 mm Hg
B. 35 mm Hg
C. 61 mm Hg
D. 0 mm Hg
E. 81 mm Hg
Answer only with the option chosen
cases.prompt_zh: 简述肺栓塞 (PE) 的经典三联征及其确诊金标准检查。

cases.prompt:
Two days after undergoing transsphenoidal removal of a pituitary macroadenoma, a 35-year-old woman reports increased thirst and frequent urination. The surgery was uncomplicated. Neurologic examination shows no abnormalities. Her serum sodium concentration is 153 mEq/L and fasting serum glucose concentration is 92 mg/dL. Which of the following findings in the nephron best describes the tubular osmolality, compared with serum, in this patient?
A. Distal ascending loop of Henle is hypertonic
B. Distal descending loop of Henle is hypotonic
C. Proximal convoluted tubule is hypertonic
D. Collecting duct is hypotonic
E. Distal convoluted tubule is hypertonic
Answer only with the option chosen
cases.prompt_zh: 甲状腺功能亢进危象（甲亢危象）的主要临床特征及综合抢救方案是什么？

cases.prompt:
An investigator is studying patients with acute decompensated congestive heart failure. He takes measurements of a hormone released from atrial myocytes, as well as serial measurements of left atrial and left ventricular pressures. The investigator observes a positive correlation between left atrial pressures and the serum level of this hormone. Which of the following is most likely the mechanism of action of this hormone?
A. Decreases sodium reabsorption at the collecting tubules
B. Increases potassium excretion at the collecting ducts
C. Constricts afferent renal arteriole
D. Decreases reabsorption of bicarbonate in the proximal convoluted tubules
E. Increases free water reabsorption from the distal tubules
Answer only with the option chosen
cases.prompt_zh: 急性胰腺炎的最常见病因是什么？血清淀粉酶与脂肪酶何者特异性更高？

cases.prompt:
An investigator is studying the effect of antihypertensive drugs on cardiac output and renal blood flow. For comparison, a healthy volunteer is given a placebo and a continuous infusion of para-aminohippuric acid (PAH) to achieve a plasma concentration of 0.02 mg/ml. His urinary flow rate is 1.5 ml/min and the urinary concentration of PAH is measured to be 8 mg/ml. His hematocrit is 50%. Which of the following values best estimates cardiac output in this volunteer?
A. 3 L/min
B. 6 L/min
C. 8 L/min
D. 1.2 L/min
E. 4 L/min
Answer only with the option chosen
cases.prompt_zh: 系统性红斑狼疮 (SLE) 最特异性的自身抗体是什么？

cases.prompt:
An investigator is studying mechanisms of urea excretion in humans. During the experiment, a healthy male volunteer receives a continuous infusion of para-aminohippurate (PAH) to achieve a PAH plasma concentration of 0.01 mg/mL. A volume of 1.0 L of urine is collected over a period of 10 hours; the urine flow rate is 1.66 mL/min. The urinary concentration of PAH is measured to be 3.74 mg/mL and his serum concentration of urea is 0.2 mg/mL. Assuming a normal filtration fraction of 20%, which of the following best estimates the filtered load of urea in this patient?
A. 25 mg/min
B. 620 mg/min
C. 124 mg/min
D. 7 mg/min
E. 166 mg/min
Answer only with the option chosen
cases.prompt_zh: 重症肌无力 (MG) 的发病机制是什么？首选抗胆碱酯酶药物是什么？

cases.prompt:

D. Constriction of the afferent arteriole

An investigator is attempting to assess the glomerular filtration rate (GFR) of a healthy adult volunteer. It is found that the estimated GFR based on the volunteer's creatinine clearance is 129 mL/min and the estimated GFR calculated using the inulin clearance is 122 mL/min. Which of the following is the best explanation for the difference in these measurements?
A. Creatinine is not freely filtered
B. Inulin is passively reabsorbed
C. Inulin is actively secreted
D. Inulin is not freely filtered
E. Creatinine is passively reabsorbed
F. Creatinine is actively secreted
Answer only with the option chosen
